title: 第3章 只喜你一人第4章 师尊被掳走了
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
看到这一幕，就连一向沉稳持重的越阳子
脸上的镇静也彻底保持不住了，瞳孔骤然收缩，脸色瞬间变得极其难看。
此时，他悬浮于身前的本命灵剑，剑锋猛地一颤。
随即便凌厉无比地指向了半空中那撑着红伞，揽着蔺兰舟的白露。
其剑身因为主人愤怒发出了阵阵嗡鸣。
“前辈！您这是何意？！”
越阳子的声音因震惊与愤怒而微微拔高，带着一丝难以置信。
“为何要强行掳走我宗之人，还请前辈立刻放开，万事好商量！”
而他身后，那个原本就曾出声呵斥白露的紫袍长老。
此刻更是气得浑身发抖，一张老脸涨得通红，如同猪肝一般。
“呸！你这不知廉耻的老妖婆！眼光倒是不错！”
他怒发冲冠，指着白露破口大骂，“但我浮云剑宗的人，岂是能随意掳走的？！”
这紫袍长老话音刚落，仿佛点燃了导火索。
周围那些早已义愤填膺的浮云剑宗弟子们，在长老的怒喝与宗主剑指强敌激励下。
几乎是不约而同地，齐刷刷地拔出了自己腰间的佩剑！
霎时间，剑光如林，寒芒闪烁。
伴随着阵阵怒吼，无数道剑光，如同万千流光一样。
齐齐向着半空中的白露疾射而去。
剑气破空之声尖锐刺耳，声势浩大，仿佛要将那片天空都撕裂。
白露看到这铺天盖地袭来的万千剑光，帷帽下的红唇却是微微一勾。

露出一抹似笑非笑，带着几分轻蔑与玩味的弧度。
她甚至没有做出任何防御或闪避的姿态。
只是极其随意地轻轻挥了挥早就将红伞收回的那只素手。
随着她这看似轻描淡写的一挥。
那原本气势汹汹的万千道凌厉剑光，在距离她身前不远处。
就那么悄无声息地凭空消失不见了。
仿佛从未出现过一般，连一丝涟漪都未曾激起，如同泥牛入海，了无痕迹。
随后，她才好整以暇地用平淡语气。
对着下方一众惊骇欲绝，目瞪口呆的浮云剑宗众人说道：
“这般雕虫小技，就不要在本座面前班门弄斧了。”
她的声音并不大，却清晰地传入了每个人的耳中。
带着一种居高临下的漠然。
“这人本座就带走了。”
她顿了顿，目光似乎扫过下方众人，补充了一句：
“日后若举行双修大典，定会派人送来请柬，邀你浮云剑宗前来喝上一杯喜酒。”
话音未落，白露的身影连同被她揽在怀中的蔺兰舟，便在众目睽睽之下，骤然消散了。
而白露在带着蔺兰舟赶回合欢宗的路上，还抽空低头瞥了一眼被自己强行掳来，此刻正被自己揽在身侧，动弹不得的男人。
嗯，近距离看，虽然感觉也和别人看不出来什么差别
感觉都是一双眼睛，一个鼻子和一张嘴。
但他只要是修真界第一美男就足够了！

只不过让白露略感奇怪的是，这位修真界第一美男竟然还染了一头银白如雪的长发？
content_en:
Seeing this scene, even Yue Yangzi, who had always been calm and steady,
The composure on his face could not be maintained at all, his pupils suddenly shrank, and his face instantly became extremely ugly.
At this time, the edge of his natal spiritual sword suspended in front of him trembled violently.
Then he pointed fiercely at Bai Lu, who was holding a red umbrella and holding Lin Lanzhou in mid-air.
The blade of the sword hummed due to the owner's anger.
"Senior! What do you mean by this?!"
Yue Yangzi's voice was slightly raised due to shock and anger, with a hint of disbelief.
"Why are you forcibly abducting members of my sect? Senior, please let go immediately. Everything can be easily discussed!"
Behind him was the purple-robed elder who had scolded Bai Lu.
At this moment, his whole body was shaking with anger, and his old face was as red as pig liver.
"Bah! You shameless old witch! You do have good taste!"
He was so angry that he pointed at Bai Lu and cursed loudly, "But how can people from my Fuyun Sword Sect be kidnapped at will?!"
As soon as the purple-robed elder finished speaking, he seemed to have lit a fuse.
The surrounding disciples of the Fuyun Sword Sect, who were already filled with righteous indignation, were inspired by the elders' angry shouts and the sect leader pointing his sword at the powerful enemy.
Almost in unison, they all pulled out the swords on their waists!
In an instant, the sword light was like a forest, and the cold light flashed.
Accompanied by bursts of roars, countless sword lights appeared like thousands of streams of light.
They all shot towards the white dew in mid-air.
The sound of the sword energy breaking through the air was sharp and harsh, and the sound was so powerful that it seemed to tear the sky apart.
When Bai Lu saw the overwhelming sword light, her red lips under the curtain twitched slightly.
He showed a faint smile, with a hint of contempt and amusement.
She didn't even make any defensive or evasive gesture.
He just waved the bare hand that had already withdrawn the red umbrella very casually.
With her seemingly indifferent gesture.
The originally menacing thousands of sharp sword lights were not far in front of her.
It just disappeared into thin air without any sound.
It was as if it had never appeared before, not even a ripple was stirred, like a mud cow entering the sea, leaving no trace.
Then, she calmly spoke in a calm tone.
He said to the horrified and dumbfounded Fuyun Sword Sect below:
"Such a small skill, don't do it in front of me."
Her voice was not loud, but it reached everyone's ears clearly.
With a condescending indifference.
"I will take this person away."
She paused, her eyes seemed to scan the people below, and added:
"If a double cultivation ceremony is held in the future, someone will definitely send an invitation to you, Fuyun Sword Sect, to come and have a glass of wedding wine."
Before she finished speaking, Bai Lu's figure and Lin Lanzhou, who was held in her arms, suddenly disappeared in front of everyone.
While Bai Lu was taking Lin Lanzhou on her way to the Huanhuan Sect, she took the time to glance down at the man who had been forcibly captured by her and was currently held by her side, unable to move.
Well, if you look at it from a close distance, you can’t tell any difference from others.
It feels like they are all a pair of eyes, a nose and a mouth.
But as long as he is the most beautiful man in the world of cultivation, it is enough!
But what makes Bai Lu feel a little strange is that the most beautiful man in the world of cultivation actually has long hair that is as white as snow?
